fee_notes: Fee varies by number of territories purchased: $59,500 for 1 territory, $99,500 for 2 ($49,750 each), $134,500 for 3 ($44,833.33 each), $164,500 for 4 ($41,125 each), $194,500 for 5 ($38,900 each). Multi-territory discount requires all franchise agreements signed simultaneously. A 25% veteran's discount is available for honorably discharged veterans owning 51%+ of the franchised business (applied to first franchised business only), which would reduce the single-territory fee to $44,625. Fees are nonrefundable. Franchisor may negotiate fee for existing operators opening additional locations or takeovers.
raw_excerpt:
$59,500 for One Franchise Territory/Franchise Agreement
$99,500 for Two Franchise Territories/Franchise Agreements ($49,750 each)
$134,500 for Three Franchise Territories/Franchise Agreements ($44,833.33 each)
$164,500 for Four Franchise Territories/Franchise Agreements ($41,125 each)
$194,500 for Five Franchise Territories/Franchise Agreements ($38,900 each)

To receive the multi-territory discounted initial franchise fee, the franchise agreements for all territories being purchased must be signed at the same time. All Initial Franchise Fees are payable in full and in a lump sum when you sign the applicable Franchise Agreement.

We offer qualified franchise candidates a 25% reduction off the Initial Franchise Fee for their first Franchised Business.
